# crosswork_aaa_sso_services (Resource)

This resource can manage the SSO service providers used for identity federation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_aaa_sso_services" "example" {
  services = [
    {
      name              = "cwtestsso"
      evaluation_order  = 3
      metadata          = "PE1ldGFkYXRhLz4="
      metadata_location = "cwtest-metadata.xml"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `services` (Attributes List) SSO service providers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Required:

- `evaluation_order` (Number) Order in which the service providers are evaluated
- `metadata` (String) SAML metadata XML of the service provider, base64 encoded
- `metadata_location` (String) File name of the metadata
- `name` (String) Name of the service provider, letters and digits only

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_aaa_sso_services.example "aaa_sso_services"
```
